Definition: from a compound of G1722 and G1218; to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively):--be at home (present).
BiblicalUsage: To be at home — in one's own country. Paul says while we are at home in the body we are absent from the Lord in 2 Corinthians 5:6, but we are willing rather to be absent from the body and present with the Lord in 2 Corinthians 5:8, and so we labour to be accepted of Him whether present or absent in 2 Corinthians 5:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe home is not this body — it is with the Lord, and this life is a stay away from home. I hold that knowing where home is changes how I live here: I labour to please Him, whether I am present or absent, because He is the one I am coming home to.
